Read: 47 plan rulings, each with at least one step, yet R28's one-store part had none until step page-data-one-store (11:30 CST). Owner 11:31 CST: "probably both is fine -- and note that the id's probably need good tagging right slugs or whatever or that won't matter here?" 1. Each numbered part of a plan ruling names its step by slug (step:<slug>); an opaque id such as c55 carries a short gloss. 2. A check on the plan flags a part with no step, or a step that no longer exists. 3. At each batch merge, the queue-score-plus-agent agent reads the plan's rulings against the steps and files what is missing. Home: decision session-tiers.
